name: Band Pallof Press

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Dr. Stuart McGill Rotary Torso Stabilization

steps: Anchor a resistance band at chest height and stand sideways to the anchor point with feet shoulder-width apart.
Clasp the band handle with both hands at the center of your chest, stepping away from the anchor to create lateral tension.
Soften your knees, engage your core, and press your hands straight forward in front of your chest.
Hold your hands extended directly forward for two seconds, strongly resisting the band's rotational pull toward the anchor.
Slowly bring your hands back into your chest, complete your reps, then turn to face the opposite direction.
coaching_cues: Do not allow your torso, hips, or knees to twist toward the anchor point; keep your body locked square.
Breathe out as you press forward and hold.
If your body begins to twist or shake uncontrollably, step slightly closer to the anchor to reduce tension.
